# NoPayToWin

`system`

No pay-to-win — monetary transactions never grant gameplay advantages over non-paying players.

## Attributes

_No fields._

## Actions

### enforce

Block any monetization mechanism that affects gameplay balance

**Conditions:**
- Cosmetics only in the shop; no power, XP boosts, inventory upgrades, or exclusive gear
- Optional subscription grants access to official server infrastructure, not gameplay advantages
